Hi again! 🌱 Thanks for checking before signing up.

**If you've used free shipping, you wouldn't get the refund.** Free Standard shipping is one of the Leafy Plus benefits. The full refund only applies if you cancel within **14 days** of purchase **and** haven't used any benefits.

If you cancel after using free shipping:
- There's **no refund** of the $59.
- Your benefits **continue to the end of your paid year**.

If you're still deciding, you could hold off on orders that use the free shipping until you're sure. Once you're past the 14 days or have used a benefit, the membership is yours for the year.

**A correction to my last message:** I said the 90-day guarantee only covers plants ordered while you're a member, and that earlier plants keep a 30-day guarantee. I can't confirm either detail from the information I have, so please don't rely on it. I can escalate to a Support Lead to get you a clear answer before you sign up.

Is there anything else I can help with? 💚
